role: A post-open mechanism attribution on the 24 independently reproduced v201 five-camera failures. It is not a deployable initializer, fresh validation, test evidence, a resource result, external generalization, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Are the 24 v201 gradient failures explained by observation-visible residual error that a minimum-norm row-space closure can remove, or do they remain after the unique observation-visible correction and therefore require a new prior, additional physical information, or more views?
reason_for_priority: v200 Huber and v201 TGV2 both left the same 24 failures while v201 improved observation error on all 1313 cells. Before adding another prior, v202 directly tests whether the remaining error is still observable to the frozen five-camera operator.

data_isolation.trajectory_role: historically exposed post-open development attribution only
data_isolation.failure_roster_source: the exact false entries of v201 tgv2_pdhg_reference strict_masks.npy, independently reproduced before v202
prediction_phase_inputs: sealed v201 TGV2 field for the roster cell
reported five-camera geometry and exact sparse operator
prediction_phase_forbidden_inputs: post-v201 pass mask beyond the frozen roster
data_isolation.truth_access: truth opens only after all 24 minimum-norm corrections, corrected fields, solver diagnostics, hashes, and the prediction barrier are sealed

primary_attribution.name: minimum_norm_observable_residual_closure
primary_attribution.formal_solver: scipy.sparse.linalg.lsqr(A,b) from zero with damp=0, atol=1e-13, btol=1e-13, conlim=1e15, iter_lim=16384
primary_attribution.independent_solver: scipy.sparse.linalg.lsmr(A,b) from zero with damp=0, atol=1e-13, btol=1e-13, conlim=1e15, maxiter=16384
primary_attribution.row_space_correction: r is the minimum-Euclidean-norm solution of A*r=b and therefore lies in range(A^T)
primary_attribution.post_truth_error_decomposition: after sealing, e=truth-x_v201 and n=e-r; report field and physical-gradient norms, gradient alignment, row/null orthogonality, and A*n leakage
primary_attribution.scope: known-failure attribution only; the truth-derived roster makes this non-deployable even though r itself uses only observation and geometry

required_diagnostics: parent and corrected field/gradient/observation metrics for all 24 cells
row correction norm divided by parent error norm
null component norm divided by parent error norm
physical-gradient row and null norms divided by parent gradient-error norm
cosine between null gradient and total gradient error
LSQR or LSMR iteration and normal-residual diagnostics

cost_accounting.parent_v201_reference: 259A+258A^T per field, inherited diagnostic cost only
cost_accounting.v202_correction: record actual LSQR or LSMR iterations and conservative sparse A/A^T diagnostic calls for every roster cell

fixed_decision_order: Any parent binding, roster, isolation, finite, convergence, closure, null-leakage, orthogonality, permutation, seal, call-ledger, or independent-comparison failure makes v202 inconclusive.

If all 24 corrected cells pass the unchanged strict absolute gate, conclude PASS_OBSERVABLE_ROWSPACE_SOLVER_HEADROOM_V202: the v201 residual still contained enough observable information and a different classical solve is warranted.
If between one and 23 corrected cells pass, conclude MIXED_ROWSPACE_AND_NULLSPACE_FAILURE_V202 and report the exact rescue roster without promoting a new algorithm.

If zero corrected cells pass, conclude FAIL_NO_OBSERVABLE_ROWSPACE_RESCUE_V202: exact residual closure cannot repair any v201 failure, so the next mechanism must add a prior, more views, or new physical information rather than improve data fitting alone.

No v202 outcome proves mathematical impossibility for every prior or estimator, and no outcome authorizes a learned model, GPU rental, exact-call reduction, wall/RSS, fresh validation, test access, external generalization, real BOST, paper success, first/SOTA/global uniqueness, or algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: Do not tune LSQR/LSMR tolerances, add damping, alter the failure roster, or replace the minimum-norm row-space question after results. A valid zero-rescue result closes residual-only solver refinement on these v201 failures; a mixed or positive result only authorizes a separately frozen solver mechanism.
